reference: Apollo DN3500, Domain/OS SR10.4, HP VUE 2.01 on the assistant clone

finding.user_report: After screen activation, MAME still captures the host pointer even though AltGr had been used to release it.
finding.implementation_boundary: The custom mouse-altgr.lua hook only observes right-Alt key transitions while MAME polls input, and toggles the guest mouse option/input sequences. That reported guest-input state is not proof that MAME/SDL host-pointer capture is released, particularly across window/screen activation.
finding.safe_action: Called the existing hook release function through the live bridge; no physical mouse click, guest file change, launch-option change, or restart.

limits: The bridge exposes guest-device state, not SDL host-capture state. Do not claim this fixes host capture. Next diagnose the MAME/SDL host release path without changing the original VM or restarting this clone before preserving guest state.
